result.analyst_notes: Mission-led and aspirational, with environmental transition as the headline frame. Uses plural first-person 'we' and absolute phrasing such as 'greatest environmental benefit possible'. Safety is framed as priority before fun. Employee, shareholder and integrity themes are largely absent; EEO language appears only as legal boilerplate in the recruiting section.
